subject: planner: fix the issue of inconsistent judgment of const false. (#62723)
summary: Unifies const-false detection across planner predicate simplification and TableDual conversion by introducing `logicalop.IsConstFalse` (treats `NULL` as unsatisfiable for filtering semantics) and using it in `Conds2TableDual` and OR-branch pruning/unsatisfiable checks. Also fixes `logicalConstant` to classify constant `NULL` as false and makes `pruneEmptyORBranches` return/propagate early unsatisfiable results so they can collapse to a single const-false predicate (enabling TableDual). Later upstream/master keeps the same semantics (code moved/refactored but behavior preserved).
